verses.en: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
verses.pt: Eu vos recomendo a nossa irmã Febe, que é servidora da Igreja que está em Cencreia,
verses.en_web: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
verses.en_bbe: It is my desire to say a good word for Phoebe, who is a servant of the church in Cenchreae:

verses.en: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
verses.pt: para que a recebais no Senhor, como convém aos santos; e para que a ajudeis em qualquer coisa que necessitar de vós; pois ela tem ajudado a muitos, inclusive a mim mesmo.
verses.en_web: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
verses.en_bbe: That you will take her in kindly, after the way of the saints, as one who is the Lord's, and give her help in anything in which she may have need of you: because she has been a help to a great number and to myself.

verses.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
verses.pt: Saudai a Priscila e a Áquila, meus cooperadores em Cristo Jesus,
verses.en_web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, workers with me in Christ Jesus,

verses.en: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
verses.pt: que arriscaram seus pescoços por minha vida; a eles não somente eu agradeço, como também todas as igrejas dos gentios.
verses.en_web: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
verses.en_bbe: Who for my life put their necks in danger; to whom not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are in debt:

verses.en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
verses.pt: Saudai também a igreja que se reúne na casa deles. Saudai Epêneto, meu amado, que é o primeiro fruto da Acaia para Cristo.
verses.en_web: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And say a kind word to the church which is in their house. Give my love to my dear Epaenetus, who is the first fruit of Asia to Christ.

verses.en: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
verses.pt: Saudai Maria, que trabalhou muito por nós.
verses.en_web: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Mary, who gave much care to you.

verses.en: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.pt: Saudai Andrônico e Júnia, meus parentes, e meus companheiros na prisão, que são notáveis entre os apóstolos, e também estavam antes de mim em Cristo.
verses.en_web: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Andronicus and Junia, my relations, who were in prison with me, who are noted among the Apostles, and who were in Christ before me.

verses.en: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
verses.pt: Saudai Amplias, meu amado no Senhor.
verses.en_web: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Ampliatus, who is dear to me in the Lord,

verses.en: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.pt: Saudai Urbano, nosso cooperador em Cristo, e Estáquis, meu amado.
verses.en_web: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Urbanus, a worker in Christ with us, and to my dear Stachys.

verses.en: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
verses.pt: Saudai Apeles, aprovado em Cristo. Saudai os que são da casa de Aristóbulo.
verses.en_web: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Apelles, who has the approval of Christ. Say a kind word to those who are of the house of Aristobulus.

verses.en: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
verses.pt: Saudai Herodião, meu parente. Saudai os que são da casa de Narciso, que estão no Senhor.
verses.en_web: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Herodion, my relation. Say a kind word to those of the house of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

verses.en: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
verses.pt: Saudai Trifena e Trifosa, que trabalham no Senhor. Saudai a amada Pérside, que trabalhou muito no Senhor.
verses.en_web: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, workers in the Lord. Give my love to my dear Persis, who did much work in the Lord.

verses.en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.pt: Saudai Rufo, o escolhido no Senhor, e a mãe dele, e minha também.
verses.en_web: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Rufus, one of the Lord's selection, and to his mother and mine.

verses.en: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
verses.pt: Saudai Asíncrito, Flegonte, Hermas, Pátrobas, Hermes e os irmãos que estão com eles.
verses.en_web: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

verses.en: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
verses.pt: Saudai Filólogo, Júlia, Nereu e sua irmã, Olimpas, e todos os santos que estão com eles.
verses.en_web: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
verses.en_bbe: Give my love to Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

verses.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
verses.pt: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com beijo santo. As igrejas de Cristo vos saúdam.
verses.en_web: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
verses.en_bbe: Give one another a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send their love to you.

verses.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
verses.pt: E rogo-vos, irmãos, que sejais cuidadosos com os que causam divisões e obstáculos contrários à doutrina que aprendestes; e afastai-vos deles;
verses.en_web: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
verses.en_bbe: Now, it is my desire, brothers, that you will take note of those who are causing division and trouble among you, quite against the teaching which was given to you: and keep away from them.

verses.en: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
verses.pt: pois tais pessoas não servem ao nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, mas sim, ao próprio ventre; e com palavras suaves e elogios enganam os corações dos ingênuos.
verses.en_web: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
verses.en_bbe: For such people are not servants of the Lord Christ, but of their stomachs; and by their smooth and well-said words the hearts of those who have no knowledge of evil are tricked.

verses.en: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
verses.pt: Pois a vossa obediência chegou ao conhecimento de todos. Por isso eu me alegro por vossa causa; quero, porém, que sejais sábios no bem, e inocentes quanto ao mal.
verses.en_web: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
verses.en_bbe: For all have knowledge of how you do what you are ordered. For this reason I have joy in you, but it is my desire that you may be wise in what is good, and without knowledge of evil.

verses.en: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.pt: E o Deus de paz esmagará Satanás em pedaços debaixo dos vossos pés. A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja convosco. Amém!
verses.en_web: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.en_bbe: And the God of peace will be crushing Satan under your feet before long. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

verses.en: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
verses.pt: Saúdam-vos o meu cooperador Timóteo, e os meus parentes Lúcio, Jáson, e Sosípatro.
verses.en_web: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
verses.en_bbe: Timothy, who is working with me, sends his love to you, so do Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my relations.

verses.en: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.pt: Eu, Tércio, que escrevi esta carta, vos saúdo no Senhor.
verses.en_web: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: I, Tertius, who have done the writing of this letter, send love in the Lord.

verses.en: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
verses.pt: Gaio, hospedeiro meu e toda a igreja, vos saúda. Erasto, tesoureiro da cidade, vos saúda, e também o irmão Quarto.
verses.en_web: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
verses.en_bbe: Gaius, with whom I am living, whose house is open to all the church, sends his love, so does Erastus, the manager of the accounts of the town, and Quartus, the brother.

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com todos vós, Amém!
verses.en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

verses.en: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
verses.pt: Ora, para aquele que tem o poder de vos manter firmes segundo o meu Evangelho e a pregação de Jesus Cristo, conforme a revelação do mistério, que foi encoberto desde o princípio dos tempos;
verses.en_web: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
verses.en_bbe: Now to him who is able to make you strong in agreement with the good news which I gave you and the preaching of Jesus Christ, in the light of the revelation of that secret which has been kept through times eternal,

verses.en: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
verses.pt: Mas agora se manifestou, e se tornou conhecido pelas Escrituras dos profetas, segundo o mandado do Deus eterno, para a obediência da fé entre todas as nações;
verses.en_web: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
verses.en_bbe: But is now made clear; and by the writings of the prophets, by the order of the eternal God, the knowledge of it has been given to all the nations, so that they may come under the rule of the faith;

verses.en: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
verses.pt: Ao único Deus sábio seja a glória, por meio de Jesus Cristo, para todo o sempre! Amém! Escrita de Corinto aos Romanos, e enviada por Febe, servidora da igreja de Cencreia.
verses.en_web: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: To the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be the glory for ever. So be it.
